label: Diagram 2.3
caption: Diagram 2.3 | Minimum door and hall widths and restrictions on localised obstructions
description: This is a floor plan of a hallway with several doorways, drawn as black outline walls with door‑swing arcs. A main horizontal passage runs across the top, with a narrower branch descending in the middle. From the left, vertical dimensions read 900mm and 1050mm, and a horizontal double arrow reads 2m max. A door arc above the passage is dimensioned 775mm, and a 1500mm horizontal dimension marks the passage before a 300mm by 300mm notch. The descending branch is dimensioned 1500mm vertically, 300mm horizontally at its entry, and 1200mm at its foot, with a door arc marked 750mm. On the right, a door arc is dimensioned 800mm above, with 1500mm, 900mm, 800mm and 300mm dimensions around a further opening and a 750mm vertical dimension at the far right. Grey shading fills certain wall zones; dotted lines outline others. A Key states the grey swatch means "Localised obstruction not permitted in shaded zone" and the dotted swatch means "Permitted obstruction". Note 1 reads "300mm nib only required where door opens inward (shown dotted)." Footnote text reads "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted".
